facts: Machine reading is a relatively new field.
The computer programs are designed to read flowing text.
The computer programs extract fact assertions expressed by the narrative content.
Machine reading involves two core technologies: natural language processing (NLP) and information extraction (IE).
A machine reading system has been developed within a cognitive architecture.
The framework integrates several levels of knowledge for a particular domain.
The framework integrates ideas from cognitive semantics.
The framework integrates ideas from construction grammar.
The framework integrates tools from prior NLP and IE research.
The system is capable of reading complex and fairly idiosyncratic texts in the family history domain.
The system is capable of interpreting complex and fairly idiosyncratic texts in the family history domain.
The paper describes the architecture of the system.
The paper describes the performance of the system.
The paper presents results from several evaluations.
The paper summarizes possible future directions.
